derived: LLY turned 14.30% of revenue into free cash over 2018 to 2025 against the 38.1% its filed expense lines leave. Restated before interest: LLY paid $3,152mm of interest inside operating cash flow over 2018 to 2025, 1.17% of revenue. The free cash flow above is struck after it and the valuation already charges the debt by subtracting net debt, so the charge falls by that much, from 28.46% to 27.30%. Restated at replacement capex: LLY spent $23,144mm on plant over 2018 to 2025 against $7,255mm of plant depreciation, 5.89% of revenue above what keeps the plant running. Taken at depreciation, the charge falls from 27.30% to 20.25%. Checked without one-off cash: deal payments are booked under investing, so free cash flow never carried them, and no settlement or transition tax is stated for the window, so the charge stands. Restated without working capital build: over 2018 to 2025 LLY's cash flow statement shows receivables up $15,658mm, inventories up $10,223mm, payables and accrued liabilities up $18,257mm, a working capital build of $7,624mm, 2.83% of revenue. Growth ties that cash up once, not on every product for ever, so the charge falls from 20.25% to 16.87%.

column11: ANCHOR, a measured analogue: degludec (Tresiba), the last new basal insulin molecule to take US share, approved 2015-09-25 (openFDA BLA203314) with 170 Part D beneficiaries in 2015 and 64,025 in 2016, so 2016 is its first full year. In 2020, year index 4, it accounted for 17.4% of the 4.9 million ambulatory insulin treatment visits of US adults with type 2 diabetes (IQVIA National Disease and Therapeutic Index; JAMA Netw Open 2021;4:e2128782, doi:10.1001/jamanetworkopen.2021.28782, PMC8511976). Solved through the engine's identity on this pool (27,000,000 x 0.2146 = 5,794,200; inflow 297,750), carryover 1.0, this row's curve (k 2.16, midpoint 0.25) and 32.1% discontinuation: starts 151,011, 350,636, 407,173, 408,026 and 401,554 over years 0 to 4, stock 151,011, 453,172, 714,877, 893,427 and 1,008,191, which is 17.4% of the pool in year 4 at a peak of 0.067326. MULTIPLE 0.25, A JUDGEMENT: 0.25 x 0.067326 = 0.016831. For more: glucose-dependent action aims at hypoglycaemia, the risk a US comparison found lower on degludec than on glargine U300, with 27% fewer stopping (CONFIRM, Diabetes Obes Metab 2019, doi:10.1111/dom.13616, PMC6590449). Against: its Phase 2 tests only non-inferiority on time in range against degludec; it would launch after the weekly insulins (efsitora, submitted) into a shrinking insulin market (ambulatory insulin visits fell from 6.0 million in 2016 to 4.9 million in 2020 in the same IQVIA series); and at 2026 list prices the category pays little. Re-solved 2026-10-05 after untreated patients were given an exit (carryover P/(P+I)): the same target now needs 0.0195533, was 0.016831 (the anchor path, now at carryover 0.9511, solves to 0.0782134, was 0.0673259, times the multiple of 0.25).
